hero.headline: The savings are hiding in the gaps
hero.sub: A fruit grower runs on a dozen tools that never speak to each other. Labour in one, transport in another, yield and quality somewhere else again. Ripely joins that data up and puts modern AI to work on it, so your team spends the day on the fruit instead of the spreadsheets.

problem.lead: You've already paid for the software: a tool for picking, one for payroll, another for haulage. None of them talk, so money leaks in the gaps between them, and someone loses an evening stitching it together by hand.

stats.label: What smarter picker transport alone saved one large grower. That is a single project, not the whole of it.
Seasonal workers to place in the right field each day at peak, one of many moving parts we pull together.
To prove the saving on your own numbers before you commit to anything.

product.heading: Connect the data first. Then put it to work for you.

cards.title: One integration layer
cards.body: Labour, transport, yield, quality and cost, lifted out of their separate tools and into one place where the numbers line up. We add one integration at a time, starting with whatever is costing you most.

cards.title: AI that does the boring bit
cards.body: The stitching, chasing and reconciling that eats your team's week, handled by agents running in the background. Your people spend their time on the judgement calls, not on data entry.

cards.title: Picker transport & routing
cards.body: Our first project. Match the crews you have to the fields that are ready, and get them there without the daily scramble. Fewer empty seats, fewer idle pickers, and less fruit left too long on the cane. More projects follow.

approach.leadStart: We build on a working farm,
approach.leadEnd: Ripely is developed alongside one of the UK's largest berry growers.

points.title: We know soft fruit
points.body: Built around the way berries are grown, picked and moved, down to the punnet.

points.title: Earns its place on the farm
points.body: Everything we ship has to prove itself in a live operation before it reaches you.

points.title: A season to earn trust
points.body: We show the saving on your own numbers before you sign up to more.

contact.heading: We can help you
contact.sub: Send a line about your operation and the tools you're using, what issues you're having, what admin is wasting your time. We'll tell you what we'd connect first.
